description: The plot illustrates how “Reliability Score” varies with “Cost” for three ensemble configurations, shown as three colored lines with markers. The x-axis is labeled “Cost,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 10 with tick labels at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. The y-axis is labeled “Reliability Score,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 30 to 90 with labeled ticks at 30, 50, 70, and 90. A blue solid line with circular markers (labeled “3-Model Ensemble”) decreases slightly across the x-axis, from about 83 at cost 0 to about 79 at cost 5 and about 75 at cost 10. A red solid line with circular markers (labeled “2-Model Ensemble”) also declines, from about 85 at cost 0 to about 79 at cost 5 and about 73 at cost 10. A yellow/gold solid line with circular markers (label not fully visible in the legend) drops more steeply, from about 89 at cost 0 to about 64 at cost 5 and about 41 at cost 10.
